points.point: error 'too many requests' meaning, from Make workflow
points.sentence: That message means too many requests in one minute.

points.point: how many media uploads per minute (POST /v2/media)
points.sentence: Rate limit exceeded. Upload Media: 30 requests/minute. Publish Post: 30 requests/minute.

verdict.reason: The rate-limit entry covers the too-many-requests error from a workflow and states that media uploads are limited to 30 requests per minute.
